# Google Sans Flex

The `google_sans_flex_*.ttf` files in `src/commonMain/composeResources/font/` are static instances
(Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold, ExtraBold) of Google Sans Flex, from
https://github.com/googlefonts/googlesans-flex. Their embedded version is
`Version 4.005;[3fe7d0b9f]`. The font is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1
([OFL.txt](OFL.txt)). Collect One uses it for all brand and UI text (`appFontFamily()`).
